scope: Current public/authenticated/admin UI inputs, supported API bodies and hidden/path/header parameters; proposed fields explicitly marked. No application or database change in this planning task.

status_definitions.present_in_code: Relevant check located in current source; not a fresh test result or proof every target path is covered.
status_definitions.partial: Some checks exist; the target rule adds or changes behavior.
status_definitions.missing: Reviewed relevant current implementation; rule not present there.
status_definitions.planned: Design requirement, including newly proposed fields or generic schema coverage.

severity_definitions.error: Blocks mutation; cannot be acknowledged or disabled for integrity/access.
severity_definitions.warning: Reviewable; explicit acknowledgement when specified; store legitimate history with audit.
severity_definitions.normalization: Safe canonicalization/diff; ambiguous economic changes need explicit correction, never silent guessing.

priority_definitions.P0: Before relying on journal correctness, charging, import or privileges.

representation.check_contracts: Human-readable deterministic requirements. implementation_key refers to a future allowlisted Python validator, never eval or admin-supplied SQL/JS.
representation.decimals: Example decimal strings show exact values. Implementation must define a versioned API compatibility adapter for current numeric clients.
representation.reference_resolution: Targets use fnmatch-style field paths. All actual field paths and rule IDs are listed in input_groups.
representation.proposed_fields: Not available today. Add through normal reviewed schema/API migration before enabling dependent rules.

input_groups.title: Sign up, sign in and password recovery

email.requirement: Trim surrounding whitespace; validate a complete email, maximum 254 characters. Do not invent mailbox rules or strip + aliases.

password.requirement: Sign-up/reset 8–128 characters. Login accepts existing nonempty passwords up to provider-compatible cap. Never trim, case-fold, log or silently truncate passwords.

mode.requirement: login/signup/forgot/recovery only; choose the fields required by the active mode.

code.requirement: Auth callback code handled only by Supabase; reject expired/invalid/already-used callbacks with a recoverable screen.

redirect.requirement: Allow only this origin and known internal destinations; reject external redirects and unsafe schemes.

name.requirement: Trimmed 1–100; warn about case-insensitive duplicate names within this user.

broker.requirement: Known broker ID/display-name mapping or explicit Other / manual; preserve historical inactive broker references.

currency.requirement: INR reporting; cannot relabel existing amounts by editing this field.

initial_balance.requirement: Finite decimal >=0; 0 is valid and produces unavailable return-on-capital ratios. Not a hard cap on derivative notional.

display_name.requirement: Same trimmed 1–100 name rule as sign-up.

email.requirement: Read-only display; authenticated provider identity is authoritative.

timezone.requirement: Read-only Asia/Kolkata; display is not authority for parsing stored timestamps.

account_id.requirement: Required owned account ID; recheck at write time.

symbol.requirement: Trim/uppercase a search term, 1–40; resolve to an exact instrument rather than trusting free text.

asset_type.requirement: Existing Stocks/Options/Futures/Crypto/Indices enum; must match the resolved instrument and segment.

exchange.requirement: Supported venue enum plus valid instrument listing; Crypto is currently a category, not a specific venue.

segment.requirement: Use the instrument compatibility matrix; not just membership of the segment list.

expiry.requirement: Strict calendar date for expiring contracts; optional otherwise; no automatic weekday or current-lot assumption.

strike.requirement: Positive decimal for options only, tied to the actual listed contract.

option_type.requirement: CE/PE for options; null for non-options. Never derive Long/Short from CE/PE.

lot_size.requirement: Positive integer from metadata applicable to the contract and trade date; manual values require provenance.

current_declaration.declaration: lot_size: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=1000000)

side.requirement: Long/Short describes exposure to the selected instrument price; quantity stays positive.

status.requirement: Open/Closed/Partial/Canceled with explicit field consistency; no silent discarding of fills.

entry_price.requirement: Positive finite decimal for a filled trade. Planned unfilled orders need a separate context.

exit_price.requirement: Finite nonnegative for closed/partial fills; zero requires explicit worthless-expiry/write-off/settlement evidence.

mark_price.requirement: Optional finite nonnegative, with timestamp/source planned; null means unknown, not zero.

quantity.requirement: Positive decimal, integral shares for ordinary equities and whole valid lots for Indian F&O; crypto uses pair precision. Corporate-action fractional holdings require an explicit adjustment context.

closed_quantity.requirement: 0 for Open; total quantity for Closed; strictly between for Partial; exact decimal comparisons.

multiplier.requirement: Positive instrument-specific unit factor; exactly 1 when NSE/BSE equity/F&O quantity is already in units.

entry_time.requirement: Required valid execution timestamp; bare user/broker timestamps interpreted as IST only after format/source is known.

exit_time.requirement: Required when quantity is realized; cannot precede entry; equal timestamps are valid at available source precision.

commission.requirement: Finite INR decimal >=0; default 0 explicitly; brokerage excludes amounts already in fees.

fees.requirement: Finite INR decimal >=0; require fee-scope definition to avoid doubling entry/exit charges.

stop_loss.requirement: Optional price >=0; flag unexpected direction in historical records, distinguish original and trailed stops.

target_price.requirement: Optional price >=0; distinguish original plan and current bracket before directional blocking.

risk_amount.requirement: Optional positive INR amount; compare with price-distance risk as warning, not an automatic overwrite.

planned_entry.requirement: Optional positive price; planned versus actual difference is valid slippage.

setup.requirement: Trimmed <=100; known playbook ID proposed, or explicit custom label; prevent blank/duplicate labels.

emotion.requirement: Known mood list or versioned legacy value, <=50.

rating.requirement: Integer 1–5; omitted uses explicit default 3, not zero.

notes.requirement: Plain text/allowed Markdown <=10,000 chars; preserve user writing and render safely.

tags.requirement: At most 30 nonempty unique trimmed strings of <=100 chars; do not split a valid JSON array incorrectly.

attributes.requirement: JSON object, <=16,000 encoded UTF-8 bytes; proposed depth/key caps; reject prototype keys and nonfinite values.

mfe.requirement: Optional finite nonnegative INR excursion, not price points or percentage; define gross/net/time-window semantics.

mae.requirement: Same unit and observation window as MFE; not a signed loss field.

rules.title: Strict type and finite numeric validation

check.contract: Apply the declared type before business rules. Reject NaN/Infinity, booleans as numbers, malformed numeric strings and fractional integers. UI numeric text becomes a decimal only on valid parsing; API scalar coercion is explicitly specified.

rules.message: Enter a valid value of the required type.

rules.title: Required, blank, zero and null are distinct

check.contract: Trim only fields declared trimmable. Required text cannot be whitespace. Optional absent numeric value is null; 0 is not missing. Never convert an empty input to zero or silently default a malformed value.

rules.message: Complete this field; a blank value is different from zero.

rules.title: Enums, IDs and unknown fields

check.contract: Use backend-supported enums and typed allowlists. Reject unknown input keys on write DTOs after callers stop resending response-only fields. Snapshot migration adapters can explicitly accept documented legacy fields.

rules.message: Choose a supported value.

rules.title: Size, nesting and safe display

check.contract: Enforce per-field limits plus UTF-8 encoded byte budgets and depth caps. Render user text as text/allowed Markdown, never executable HTML; forbid unsafe URL schemes. New proposed limits are in proposed_limits.

rules.message: This value is too large or uses an unsupported format.

rules.title: Resource ownership and authorization

check.contract: Check authentication, resource ownership, entitlement and role at the server for every operation. Current roles are trusted database membership, not user metadata. Validation previews must obey the same boundaries.

rules.message: This item is unavailable or you do not have access.

rules.title: Non-destructive normalization

check.contract: Return proposed changes separately from issues. Trim/case-normalize exact symbols and trim/deduplicate tags; preserve raw imported values. Never infer side, contract, currency, unit, date format or settlement from an ambiguous label.

rules.message: Review the suggested correction before saving.

rules.title: Versions, deduplication and atomic writes

check.contract: Reject stale record/catalog versions; same idempotency key and body replays the result, different body conflicts. Write record, quota, ledger and accepted warnings atomically; recheck ownership and balances inside the transaction.

rules.message: This information changed. Refresh and review it before saving.

rules.title: Warnings cannot be forged or reused

check.contract: Bind acknowledgements to user, operation, normalized payload hash, relevant record version, policy version, instrument revision and short expiry. A changed field invalidates affected warnings. Errors are never acknowledgeable.

rules.message: Review the current warnings before continuing.

rules.title: Reject writes to server-derived values

check.contract: user_id, role, plan status, credits, P&L, fees-derived totals, payment state, is_demo and replay cursor are server-owned. Map editable fields explicitly; preserve system provenance across ordinary trade edits.

rules.message: This value is calculated or managed by the server.

rules.title: Password and account fields by mode

check.contract: Sign-up/reset uses 8–128 characters and matching provider policy; login does not force an existing password through new-password length rules. Validate email without revealing account existence; name required only when creating account.

rules.message: Use at least 8 characters for your new password.

rules.title: Recovery and callback integrity

check.contract: Use verified provider recovery/callback state; handle expired/reused codes. Never accept a user-supplied external next URL or reveal tokens in analytics/errors/logs. Do not charge or grant plans from signup query parameters.

rules.message: This sign-in link is invalid or expired. Request a new link.

rules.title: Account integrity and duplicate names

check.contract: Apply strict AccountInput bounds; trim before min/max checks. An identical normalized account name warns, rather than merging accounts. Reject changing reporting currency or deleting an account referenced by trades, income, practice sessions or saved scope.

rules.message: Check the account details and linked records.

rules.title: Zero balance and notional mismatch

check.contract: Zero starting balance is valid but percent return is undefined. Gross derivative exposure can exceed cash balance; no hard rejection on notional-to-balance alone. Negative cash due to a real correction belongs in a separate ledger type.

rules.message: Starting balance is zero, so return on capital is unavailable.

rules.title: Exact instrument resolution

check.contract: Resolve exact alias + venue + date + contract metadata. Bare NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/FINNIFTY/SENSEX cannot be equity shares. Do not use prefix matching; NIFTYBEES-like ETF names are distinct securities. Ambiguous derivatives require explicit contract selection.

rules.message: This is an index. Choose its contract, or record a reference/practice entry.

rules.title: Asset, venue and segment compatibility

check.contract: Use compatibility_matrix; known conflicts block. Changing type displays the now-incompatible fields and asks for correction rather than clearing them silently. Compatibility does not prove a contract exists.

rules.message: This market segment does not match the selected instrument.

rules.title: Reference index is not a cash execution

check.contract: Cash indices are reference instruments. Keep reference/synthetic practice separate from real executed trades and real P&L. A bare index cannot become a real filled stock by acknowledgement.

rules.message: Select a tradable contract, or save this as reference/practice data.

rules.title: Unknown and historical contracts

check.contract: When metadata is absent/stale, keep unresolved row in draft/review. Allow an explicit manually verified historical instrument with required economics and source, audit and unverified label; do not guess or reject delisted securities just because absent from current catalog.

rules.message: We could not verify this instrument for the trade date. Supply its contract details and source.

rules.title: Option and future identity

check.contract: Listed expiring F&O needs expiry and lot metadata; options additionally need strike and CE/PE. Futures cannot carry strike/option type. Spot/equity cannot carry derivative fields. Crypto perpetuals do not need an invented expiry.

rules.message: Complete the contract details for this instrument.

rules.title: Effective dates and contract economics

check.contract: Use metadata effective for that contract and execution/settlement date. No universal lot, multiplier, tick or expiry weekday; settlement chronology is distinct from trade execution chronology. Block known contradictions; unknown metadata follows INS-004.

rules.message: These contract details do not match the trade date.

rules.title: Price tick versus average fill

check.contract: Exchange tick validation applies to individual execution/order prices with reliable metadata; average prices may legitimately be between ticks. Never round a broker average silently. Strike must resolve to a listed strike, not a generic tick multiple.

rules.message: This execution price does not match the instrument tick. Verify whether it is an average fill.

rules.title: Quote currency and crypto contract types

check.contract: Require source currency and explicit conversion into INR; USDT/USD amounts cannot be relabelled INR. Linear/inverse crypto contracts need their correct valuation formula; unsupported economics must remain draft, not pass through the stock formula.

rules.message: Confirm the quote currency, conversion and contract type before calculating INR performance.

rules.title: Filled quantity must be positive

check.contract: Require positive finite value. Never store negative shares to indicate a short; canonical side is separate. Explicit broker debit/credit sign conversion is permitted only by a reviewed source profile.

rules.message: Quantity must be greater than zero.

rules.title: Valid quantity precision and whole lots

check.contract: Ordinary equity executions use whole shares. Indian F&O entered in units must be exact multiples of effective lot size, multiplier 1. Crypto uses its configured step. Corporate-action fractional entitlements use explicit adjustment context. Use Decimal, not float modulo.

rules.message: Enter a quantity in this instrument’s valid share or lot increment.

rules.title: Prevent lots multiplied twice

check.contract: If user enters lots, convert once to units using effective lot size and persist original units. For unit-quantity NSE/BSE F&O require multiplier 1; reject contradictory quantity unit and multiplier. MCX/crypto use their own instrument formula.

rules.message: Confirm whether this quantity is units or lots; it must not be multiplied twice.

rules.title: Position lifecycle consistency

check.contract: Open: closed quantity 0 and no exit. Closed: full quantity, exit price/time required. Partial: 0 < closed < total with realized exit price/time. Contradictions return errors and a proposed normalization, not silent data loss.

rules.message: The quantities and exit fields do not match this trade status.

rules.title: Canceled is unfilled, not a zero-share execution

check.contract: Separate order intent from executed position: canceled unfilled orders may have requested quantity but no executed quantity/P&L; original execution price may be absent. Keep compatibility adapter for existing Canceled records and exclude them from execution counts, P&L and fee-turnover denominators.

current_evidence: backend/schemas.py:Canceled still requires positive entry price/quantity
rules.message: Record this as an unfilled order, not a completed execution.

rules.title: Profit and loss are both legitimate

check.contract: Never require exit to be above entry for Long or below entry for Short. Long gross=(exit-entry)*realized_units*multiplier; Short reverses the sign. Same-price exits can lose money after fees. Long PE is long the option premium, not a Short position.

rules.message: This is a valid trade outcome; review the calculated net P&L.

rules.title: Scales, averages and open remainder

check.contract: Maintain fill-level conservation; closes cannot exceed open quantity. Scale-in averages and partial close averages must be weighted correctly. Until fills exist, label one-entry/average-exit limitations and do not claim per-fill execution validity.

rules.message: The realized quantity exceeds the available position or its fills do not reconcile.

rules.title: Price domains and exceptional zero prices

check.contract: Execution entry >0; exit/mark >=0 only with reason/source for zero. Planned entry >0 when supplied. Stop/target 0 normally needs correction; allow explicit valid zero-price exceptional contexts. No blanket fixed upper price cap; use precision/storage caps and typo warnings.

rules.message: Enter a valid price, or explain the zero-price settlement.

rules.title: Unit and scale typo warning

check.contract: Flag unusually large price ratios using configurable 10x price-change threshold and instrument context. Suppress expected near-zero expiry outcomes; missing price data is unknown, not proof of invalidity. Do not auto-shift decimal points.

rules.message: The price change is unusually large. Check the decimal point, unit and contract.

rules.title: Dates and timestamp ordering

check.contract: Reject invalid dates and malformed/ambiguous timestamps. Compare parsed UTC instants, not arbitrary original strings. Exit >= entry; equality is valid at source precision. Date-only expiry is not forced to midnight before same-day execution.

rules.message: Enter a valid date; an exit cannot occur before its entry.

rules.title: Future execution versus future plans

check.contract: Reject actual execution timestamps beyond configurable five-minute clock-skew allowance; near-future within skew warns. Future note/goal planning dates, expected income and option expiry are allowed. Reference/practice clocks are explicitly separate.

rules.message: This execution time is in the future. Check the date and time zone.

rules.title: Market session checks are contextual

check.contract: Out-of-session/holiday entries warn using dated venue calendar and event type. Do not hard-reject all weekends, special sessions, settlements, corporate actions or crypto trading. No calendar data means no claim of verified session validity.

rules.message: This time is outside the recorded session. Confirm the time zone and event type.

rules.title: Expiry and lifecycle boundaries

check.contract: Known contract execution after expiry blocks; same-day expiry trades and later documented settlement events are distinct valid contexts. Metadata unknown -> review instead of fabricated cut-off. Expired contracts remain valid historical journal entries.

rules.message: This execution is outside the contract’s valid trading period.

rules.title: Original bracket direction

check.contract: For an executable new Long bracket: stop < entry < target where supplied; Short reverses. For an already-executed journal record, unexpected planned direction/equality warns because it may document a real mistake. Do not erase the historical plan.

rules.message: The recorded stop or target is on an unexpected side of entry. Confirm the original plan.

rules.title: Trailing stops and replay brackets

check.contract: Replay open order compares with current execution price; bracket update compares with current market price, not original entry. Long trail above entry but below current price is valid; inverse logic for Short. Closing/step actions must not fail on hidden stale order-form values.

rules.message: The bracket must be on the correct side of the current executable price.

rules.title: Risk amount and excursion consistency

check.contract: Compare declared original risk with abs(entry-original_stop)*risk_quantity*multiplier, with defined fee inclusion. Warn only on mismatches over configured 10%; current trailing stop cannot replace original risk. MFE/MAE in INR share the same gross/full-position time window; otherwise mark incomparable.

rules.message: Check whether risk and excursion values use the same units and observation window.

rules.title: Risk calculator cannot emit invalid size

check.contract: Reject invalid numerics and risk outside 0–100%; entry==stop makes size undefined, not zero/infinity. Zero balance/risk ->0 units with explanation. Round down to valid lot/quantity step once metadata exists; if below one lot show no valid size. Current generic calculator cannot imply brokerage margin or execution eligibility.

rules.message: A valid position size needs different entry and stop prices and valid instrument units.

rules.title: High selected risk is advisory

check.contract: Warn when chosen risk exceeds proposed configurable 5% of relevant capital. Historical trade entries are not rejected and no investment recommendation is implied by the threshold.

rules.message: This risk percentage is high relative to the entered balance. Confirm it is intentional.

rules.title: Fee fields and scope

check.contract: Nonnegative finite costs for these fields; negative rebates belong in a signed adjustment component. Define whether costs are total record or realized portion. Detect brokerage/charges already combined by broker instead of summing duplicate columns.

rules.message: Enter nonnegative charges and confirm what is included.

rules.title: Charges exceed recorded trade value

check.contract: For a supported linear record in one currency, cost_basis_turnover=abs(entry*quantity*multiplier)+abs(exit*closed_quantity*multiplier) when realized. Options use premium, not underlying index notional. When total charges exceed this value and turnover>0, require explicit review; never reject solely due to this ratio.

rules.message: Charges exceed the recorded entry and exit value. Check INR units, quantity and duplicate charges.

rules.title: High fee ratio and zero-turnover exception

check.contract: Warn above proposed 1% fee/recorded-turnover ratio; per-segment thresholds are admin-editable and not tax assumptions. When turnover is zero (unfilled order/standalone fee) ratio is undefined: review charge source instead of dividing by zero. Suppress duplicate low-severity alert if FEE-002 already applies.

rules.message: Charges are high for the recorded trade value. Please review them.

rules.title: Charges consume gross profit

check.contract: If gross profit >0 and realized allocated costs >= gross profit, show informational net outcome. A profitable price move can produce zero or negative net P&L; do not reject it.

rules.message: The price move was profitable, but charges consumed the gross profit.

rules.title: Fee totals and monetary precision

check.contract: Use decimal monetary math; exact configured scope and currency. Component sums reconcile within defined paise rounding; do not compare repeated binary float calculations. Taxes/levies need dated rules before automated estimates, not hardcoded generic rates.

current_evidence: backend/analytics.py:Decimal math after float DTO conversion
rules.message: The charge breakdown does not match the total.

rules.title: Trade text, tags and JSON attributes

check.contract: Apply field-specific limits, known moods, integer rating, unique tags and bounded JSON. Typed reserved attributes for delta/gamma/theta/vega/iv need documented units. A response-only privileged key cannot be promoted from attributes to account state. Appending AI text must respect final combined note length.

rules.message: Check the labels, notes and custom data for this trade.

rules.title: Option metadata cannot contradict core fields

check.contract: Canonical contract expiry/strike/type live at top level. Reject or explicitly migrate conflicting duplicate values in custom attributes. Analytics must read the canonical fields. IV is a nonnegative fraction and can exceed 1; option-unit delta bounds require stated convention.

current_evidence: src/Analytics.tsx:Options view currently reads expiry/strike/type from attributes
rules.message: The custom option details conflict with the selected contract.

rules.title: Filter types, ranges and ownership

check.contract: All filter entry paths use the same typed validator. start<=end and inclusive IST-day bounds; empty sentinel distinct from invalid date. Limit search lengths; owned IDs only; unknown enums rejected. Invalid persisted filters require repair, not a crashing page.

rules.message: Choose a valid date range and supported filters.

rules.title: Charts and undefined statistics

check.contract: Allowlisted dimensions/metrics; divisions by zero, missing MFE/marks and no-loss profit factors shown as defined null/infinity labels, never serialized NaN/Infinity. Count actual rows and report truncation; capped results must not look like the complete journal.

rules.message: There is not enough valid data for this metric.

rules.title: Replace arbitrary record objects with typed kinds

check.contract: Each supported kind has an explicit schema and limits from the input matrix; reject unknown fields after an explicit legacy migration. Enforce on create AND update AND AI-generated saves, including required bodies, dates, checklist arrays and statuses.

rules.message: Complete the required fields for this record type.

rules.title: Names and historical references

check.contract: Warn on normalized duplicate names. Prefer stable IDs for new links; renaming a playbook must not silently relabel historical trade setups. Offer a separately reviewed migration when desired.

rules.message: An item with this name already exists. Keep both or choose a clearer name.

rules.title: Goal metric-specific targets

check.contract: Counts must be positive integers; percentage targets >0 through100; INR profit target positive finite decimal. Do not apply one generic positive float check to every metric.

rules.message: This target must use the units and range of the selected metric.

rules.title: Income semantics and dates

check.contract: Require account, typed symbol/source, status and valid date; positive received income. Zero placeholder warns; negative correction is separate type. Expected future date valid; future Received warns. Duplicate same-account/source/date/amount warns, not unconditional rejection.

rules.message: Check the income amount, payment date and whether it is expected or received.

rules.title: Dashboard settings and chart snapshots

check.contract: Only known widget IDs, valid order/permutation and hidden subset. Pins accept typed chart data or body and known saved scope. No arbitrary scripts/HTML/SQL. Preference keys and language are bounded enums.

rules.message: This layout or saved chart contains an unsupported value.

rules.title: File boundaries and supported content

check.contract: Enforce compressed/expanded/row/column/cell budgets before expensive parsing. Inspect allowed format; reject macros/external link loading/encrypted unsupported workbooks, formula cells without explicit value provenance and duplicate normalized headers. No formula evaluation.

rules.message: This file is unsupported, ambiguous or exceeds the import limits.

rules.title: Mapping and defaults must be explicit

check.contract: Each mapping destination is allowlisted and column exists. Required fields supplied. Multiple conflicting source columns do not silently pick first. Shared column use needs a defined transform; defaults must not hide malformed nonempty row data. Inspect source schema whenever loading template.

rules.message: Review the required columns and conflicting mappings.

rules.title: Buy/sell is not universal entry/exit

check.contract: For Short positions, selling may open and buying may close. Broker execution files need pairing/open-close semantics; buy price/sell price cannot always map to entry/exit. Reject unsupported fills-as-positions import or require an explicit reviewed adapter.

current_evidence: backend/importer.py:ALIASES maps buy price to entry_price and sell price to exit_price
rules.message: This file needs entry/exit mapping for its position direction. Confirm the broker format.

rules.title: Date, locale, currency and unit ambiguity

check.contract: Preserve raw cell. Reject ambiguous date formats and malformed separators; parse declared day-first/ISO profile, source zone and Excel serial type. Date-only data needs coarse-precision provenance. Do not strip currency symbols and guess INR, or guess contracts versus units.

rules.message: Confirm this file’s date format, currency and quantity units.

rules.title: One validator for preview and commit

check.contract: Run the exact same rules for manual create/update/import preview/import commit/replay export. Preview reports original row, normalized values, errors and warnings. Commit rechecks current account, policy, dedup and quota; preview is never write authority.

rules.message: The import changed since preview. Review the affected rows again.

rules.title: Duplicates and atomic row accounting

check.contract: Prefer broker execution IDs. Fingerprint fallback warns about identical-looking legitimate trades; exact known duplicate skips. Catch in-file, existing and concurrent duplicates before counting usage. Credit/trade allowances reflect inserted rows only. No silent partial success; row results enumerate saved/skipped/failed.

rules.message: These rows already exist or changed since preview. Review the import summary.

rules.title: Safe export round trip

check.contract: CSV escape formula prefixes as text without destroying genuine signed numeric values. JSON remains parseable and bounded. Export preserves currency, unit, timestamp precision and provenance so re-import cannot silently change identity.

rules.message: Some values need safe text encoding in the exported file.

rules.title: Validate OHLCV and series type

check.contract: Require list/object shape before len/index, valid strictly increasing unique instants, finite positive OHLC with high>=max(open,close,low), low<=min(open,close,high), volume absent/null or finite >=0. Empty uploaded series is an error, not synthetic fallback.

current_evidence: backend/journal_routes.py:create_simulation ignores volume and uses candles or sample
rules.message: Supply a valid, ordered OHLCV series.

rules.title: Replay action schema and state

check.contract: Discriminate by action: step only needs count; close needs position; open requires no position and unfinished session; bracket needs position. Ignore no hidden financial value silently: wrong action fields rejected or excluded by request builder. Validate relevant fields only.

rules.message: This action is not valid for the current replay state.

rules.title: Practice provenance, progress and no lookahead

check.contract: Server owns cursor, balance, fills and export checkpoint; do not accept future candle fills or replay client P&L. Practice remains practice after export AND edit. Repeated action/export requests do not duplicate fills. Historical candle replay needs disclosed gap/stop-target execution assumptions.

rules.message: This replay has changed. Refresh its current position and progress.

rules.title: Validate before charging or calling a model

check.contract: Require nonblank message, allowed enabled mode, owned conversation/trade and typed filters. A trade_note requires trade_id. Missing/stale expected cost returns conflict before reserving. User-supplied model or subscription info never chooses routing.

rules.message: Review the task, context and current credit cost before sending.

rules.title: Credit eligibility and exactly-once settlement

check.contract: Atomic current balance/entitlement/rate/active-job checks, zero-cost task allowed, one reservation per job, fail/refund once, no automatic paid retry. Model/catalog config snapshot attached to job and used by graph. Invalid inputs consume neither credits nor monthly trade quota.

rules.message: This task is unavailable or your balance has changed.

rules.title: Generated data uses ordinary validators

check.contract: Model-generated plans/charts/notes are untrusted. Validate enums, scoped filters, finite chart rows, output length and safe rendering; save only via normal authorized endpoints. Explanatory AI can suggest a correction but cannot override validation or invent contract metadata.

rules.message: The generated result needs review before it can be saved.

rules.title: Server quote and offer readiness

check.contract: Require current expected price, active plan/price, linked matching provider plan, enabled checkout and valid subscription transition. Same key cannot create duplicate external checkout; cancellation only affects authorized eligible subscription. Browser pricing hints do not grant access.

rules.message: The offer has changed or checkout is not ready. Review the current plan.

rules.title: No ambiguous active offers or invented discounts

check.contract: At most one active offer per plan/interval/currency/environment unless an explicit offer-selection model exists. Discount compares same-plan same-currency annual vs 12 monthly total; suppress savings if annual>=monthly*12 or either missing. Credits/8x badge derived from real nonzero baseline.

rules.message: Resolve duplicate active offers before publishing pricing.

rules.title: Payment and webhook integrity

check.contract: Verify raw signature, event ID dedup, retrieved provider objects, subscription ownership, amount in paise, currency, paid status, periods and refund/dispute events. Invalid/stale/out-of-order messages cannot grant access or reset credits twice.

rules.message: Payment could not be verified yet. Refresh billing after confirmation.

rules.title: Role, revision, reason and immutable history

check.contract: Support is read-only; admin handles authorized catalog/user operations; owner manages staff. Recheck active role in transaction. Require meaningful reason and optimistic revision, audit atomically, preserve immutable price/credit/payment/audit history.

rules.message: This change is not permitted or the configuration has changed.

rules.title: Credit and grant math

check.contract: Integer nonzero adjustments cannot make spendable monthly balance negative; current-month only and audit before/after. Grant needs active plan and finite future zoned expiry <=3,660 days. Grant revocation must be explicit and cannot create or cancel a provider payment.

rules.message: Check the credit adjustment or access expiry.

rules.title: Plan and feature catalog consistency

check.contract: Trim names; keep immutable supported codes; strict integer limits; null versus zero trade limit distinct; Free remains active. Enabled paid features must have implementations; upcoming metadata never unlocks anything. Preview allowance/feature impact on existing users without resetting spent credits.

rules.message: This plan has inconsistent limits, features or AI availability.

rules.title: Model existence, compatibility and budgets

check.contract: Validate ID format and registry identity, enabled references, capability-compatible parameters and response/planner requirements. Check output+input context budget and graph aggregate timeout. Warn on stale/unverified provider catalog; do not make a paid model call merely to validate a dropdown.

rules.message: This model or parameter combination is not available for the selected task.

rules.title: Product settings and readiness

check.contract: Use strict bounds, robust email/HTTPS validation and nonblank conditional fields. No embedded credentials or control characters in URLs; do not fetch arbitrary admin URLs during validation. Checkout activation requires matching offer/payment readiness; AI/rate/report limits stay coherent.

rules.message: Complete the required settings before enabling this service.

rules.title: Last owner and staff identity

check.contract: Use unique verified user ID, not ambiguous email/name search match. Only owner assigns staff; never remove final active owner, self-suspend or suspend active staff via ordinary user-edit bypass.

rules.message: Keep an active owner and use the staff-access workflow for this change.

rules.title: Search and pagination inputs

check.contract: Validate query bounds and job status enum before querying; escape LIKE wildcard input and use parameterized queries. Page sizes bounded; stale user selection cannot carry into another record after a search update.

rules.message: Enter a supported status, page or search term.

rules.title: Control behavior and error access

check.contract: Invalid numbers stay editable strings; do not replace partial input with 0. Associate messages with fields, show first invalid field on submit, preserve form content, prevent double-submit and reset stale selection/error state when dependent fields change. Search/select supports keyboard, disabled options and no-results without selecting hidden values.

rules.message: Review the highlighted fields.

rules.title: No silent change of destructive or financial intent

check.contract: Changing dependent fields previews affected values; do not clear exit fields, money, contract details or saved source context silently. A confirmation handles user intent; backend validation/ownership remains mandatory after confirmation.

rules.message: This change affects existing values. Review them before saving.
